VideoProject.title: VideoProject
VideoProject.description: A user-owned Telugu script-to-video project supporting scripts up to 10,000 words.

title.description: Project title in Telugu or English (1 to 160 characters).

scriptPreview.description: Short preview snippet of the uploaded Telugu script.

scriptText.description: Full uploaded or pasted Telugu script text (up to 10,000 words / 250,000 chars).

wordCount.description: Word count of the Telugu script.

sceneCount.description: Number of storyboard scenes generated for this project.

completedVisualsCount.description: Count of scenes with generated AI visual clips.

completedAudioCount.description: Count of scenes with generated Telugu narration audio.

visualStyle.description: Cinematic visual direction preset for AI clip generation.

voiceProfile.description: Expressive narration voice profile for synchronized Telugu narration.

captionStyle.description: Caption overlay style burned into clips and player.

stage.description: Current editable production stage of the video project.

estimatedDurationSec.description: Estimated total duration of the generated video in seconds.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on create.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on create and update.

StoryScene.title: StoryScene
StoryScene.description: A single AI-generated storyboard clip with Telugu dialogue, synced captions, visual prompt, and camera motion.

sceneIndex.description: Zero-based sequential order of this scene clip.

speaker.description: Character or narrator name speaking the dialogue.

dialogueTelugu.description: Full Telugu narration or dialogue spoken during this clip.

captionLines.description: Dialogue-aligned Telugu caption segments displayed sequentially during playback.

visualPrompt.description: Cinematic English visual generation prompt for this clip.

cameraMotion.description: Animated Ken Burns camera motion preset.

voiceDirection.description: Expressive delivery cues for human-like narration.

durationMs.description: Measured or estimated narration duration of this scene in milliseconds.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on create.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on create and update.

/users/{userId}/projects/{projectId}/sce.description: Ordered storyboard scenes and dialogue-aligned captions belonging to a VideoProject.
